reserves.name: Nereus overcollateralized crypto positions including DAI collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Nereus Finance lending-market collateral depositors (Avalanche and Polygon)

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-08-08: Nereus still describes NXUSD as an overcollateralized borrow against crypto collateral in its Avalanche and Polygon lending markets. docs.nereus.finance now redirects to the marketing landing page, and neither the landing page nor the pinned GitHub deployment manifest publishes a reconciled, dated per-market collateral inventory or weights. The envelope therefore remains one aggregate classified basket rather than invented weights. The curated-validated adapter probes live token supply and carries this reviewed composition into runtime scoring.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nereus protocol documentation; per-market collateral weights are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current per-market collateral balances and weights across Nereus lending markets are not published; the aggregate basket cannot be split into reviewed constituents.
